questions.stem_md: $f(x) = \log_{a} x$ funksiyaning grafigi $(25;\ 2)$ nuqtadan o'tadi ($a > 0$, $a \ne 1$).
questions.solution_md:
Nuqta grafikda yotgani uchun $\log_{a} 25 = 2 \Rightarrow a^{2} = 25 \Rightarrow a = 5$.

Endi qiymatni hisoblaymiz: $f(\frac{1}{125}) = \log_{5} \frac{1}{125} = \log_{5} 5^{-3} = -3$.
questions.mistake_note_md: Asosni topishda $a = q$ yoki $a = N/q$ deb olish; manfiy darajali argumentda ($1/a^r$) logarifm ishorasini unutish.
